name: Cable Single-Arm Triceps Pushdown
summary: An isolation exercise that uses a high cable pulley to train the triceps one arm at a time through elbow extension.

setup: Set a cable pulley to the highest position and attach a single D-handle or grip the bare cable end.
Grasp the handle with one hand and take a half-step back, assuming a stable staggered stance with a slight forward torso lean.
Position your upper arm close to your torso and bend your elbow fully so your hand starts near upper chest height.
steps: Keeping your upper arm fixed in place, extend your elbow downward until your arm is fully straightened.
Pause briefly at the bottom to contract your triceps.
Control the cable back up by bending your elbow until you achieve a full stretch at the top.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press the handle down to lockout and inhale as you return to the starting position.

common_faults.fault: Swinging the upper arm forward and backward during reps.
common_faults.correction: Lock your shoulder and keep your upper arm stationary so the movement comes exclusively from the elbow.

common_faults.fault: Using torso momentum or dipping the shoulder to push the weight down.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core, maintain a fixed torso angle, and reduce the load if necessary.

precautions: Avoid violently hyperextending the elbow at the bottom of the movement.
